## 9. Developer Checklist

Before requesting a review, ensure:

- [ ] Code follows project coding conventions.
- [ ] No unnecessary console logs or debugging code.
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, credentials, or sensitive information.
- [ ] No unrelated changes included.
- [ ] Code has been reviewed by the author.
- [ ] Linting passes.
- [ ] Type checking passes (if applicable).
- [ ] Relevant tests have been added or updated.
- [ ] Existing functionality has been verified.
- [ ] Documentation has been updated (if applicable).
- [ ] Breaking changes have been documented.
- [ ] Related GitHub issues / tickets are linked.
- [ ] No unnecessary dependencies have been introduced.

---
